content.title: Temptation Island Season 2 Couples Casting Tapes: Watch Before Entering the Island
content.text: Watch the Season 2 Couples Before They Entered Temptation IslandThe Temptation Island Season 2 drama started before the couples ever stepped foot on the island. Now that you’ve seen how it all unfolded, go back to where it began.Get an exclusive look at what life was like before the series for the four couples, from commitment struggles to trust and communication breakdowns. Watch the casting tapes for Sydney and Mikey, Shyanne and Jack, Kaylee and Summit, and Scarlett and Cole.Thirsty for more?
